name: EU Blue Card

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum gross monthly salary of HUF883,671 (approx. EUR2,360) for 2025, rising to HUF1,001,048 in 2026. A reduced threshold of HUF706,937 (2025) / HUF800,838 (2026) applies to healthcare professionals (doctors, pharmacists, nurses, etc.).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer meeting the current salary threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a tertiary education degree matching the job requirements, or, for ICT specialists and executives, at least 3 years of relevant professional experience acquired within the preceding 7 years.
Requires a valid employment contract for a fixed term of at least 6 months.

evidence_required.document: Degree certificate or documented professional experience
Salary documentation meeting the current threshold

outcome.duration_length: up to 4 years, extendable for up to 4 years at a time

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- EU Blue Card: 2025/2026 salary thresholds (standard and healthcare-reduced), qualification pathways, 4-year duration, intra-EU mobility

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. work_rights set to 'restricted': a change of employer triggers a mandatory renewal application. Intra-EU mobility confirmed at tier-1: holders with 12 months' prior Blue Card experience in another EU member state, or 6 months in a second member state, may apply to move. family_can_join set true by INFERENCE: Blue Card holders were not named among the sponsor-ineligible categories (seasonal employment, investment-related work, standard employment, White Card, study/training/volunteer permits) in oif.gov.hu's family-reunification factsheet -- this is an inference by omission, not an explicit tier-1 confirmation either way, and should be verified directly before relying on it.
